title: Physical-grid terrain derivatives and independent neighborhood feature bands

entry_inventory.interpretation: Names only; bounded parameter/context semantics, not complete GEE compatibility

implementation.terrain: One actual elevation band in metres, four-connected central differences; products retains all original bands/properties and appends slope/aspect/hillshade; deprecated Terrain alias shares implementation.
implementation.metric: Actual source CRS/pixel centers to WGS84 ECEF, then local tangent-chord east/north 2x2 solve. No output-CRS/scale metric substitution or implicit height scaling. Checked Long global indices, exact half-cell index bound2^52, degenerate/polar/unresolvable metrics reject.
implementation.numerics: Independent mantissa/exponent differences and range-stable gradient solve; tiny slope converts directly to degrees in log domain. Slope/aspect degrees, flat aspect0 and canonical [0,360). Periodic illumination and floor(clamp(Lambert)*255+0.5); physical hillshade remains Float64 NaN, including valid0/255.
implementation.neighborhood_bands: Nonzero signed kernel support emits row-major focus-relative input_dx_dy outputs; weight magnitude ignored. Each output is actual singleton-offset Float64 focal mean with skipMasked=false, preserving independent neighbor masks.
implementation.grid_and_masks: Full input bounds and proven common grid before merging; Float64 before temporal selection. Explicit input clip retained, output ROI/resampling downstream. Terrain requires center+four valid neighbors; missing keys never synthesized.
limits: Terrain wire1024 ASCII bytes; kernel33x33/1089 cells and offsets<=32
100000 native keys/100M decoded cells/10M per tile/1e8 per-tile work/1e9 total work unchanged
Positive halo radius must be smaller than tile dimensions; output graph checked after final selection
local_policies: WGS84 tangent-chord metric, flat aspect0 and Lambert rounding have no Google oracle
Neighborhood names are focus-relative; zero-support kernel rejects under nonempty image contract
Terrain products existing output-name collisions reject; no unsigned-byte hillshade storage claim
rejected: Nonfinite/nonstatic angles, invalid wire, undefined metrics
Meter kernels, empty neighborhood support and work/node overflow
implementation.catalog_boundary: Production EE DEM catalog adapter remains pending. Existing CatalogOperations.load admits only accepted sentinel-2-l2a and its aliases. Tests inject synthetic elevation metadata under that fixture ID; native fixtures are independent synthetic tiles, not reflectance relabeled as real elevation.

validation.actual_process_evaluator: Pinned openEO registry/evaluator tests cover terrain single-band metadata, spatial/band/resample pushdown blockers and exact source forwarding; no fabricated pixels.

legacy_probes.interpretation: Selected compile probes, not migration success rate

native_terrain.scope: Actual GeoTrellis Float64 terrain tiles, manual one-cell halo and collection BufferTilesRDD; no SparkContext/service/user code
native_terrain.reference: pyproj WGS84 transform plus Decimal-backed ECEF tangent-chord 2x2 solve
native_terrain.subnormal_tolerance: max(32 ulps, 1e-6 relative); expected output must remain nonzero
native_terrain.hillshade: Exact rounded integer comparisons, including0 and255

native_neighborhood_bands.scope: Standalone GeoTrellis Float64 focal tile-kernel invocation using six specs extracted from the pinned SDK compiler graph; no SparkContext, service, or user code
native_neighborhood_bands.comparison: Exact binary64 with independent whole-grid shift reference; manual halo assembly
coverage: all three nonzero cells from an asymmetric-focus signed 3x3 kernel across two input bands
independent whole-grid shift references for every actual Float64 tile output
masked center filled by a valid neighbor while a masked neighbor remains NoData
missing upper-right source tile treated as NoData even when backing array cells contain values
domain edges, source tile boundaries, and row-major compiler output specs

validation.final_probe_only_refinement: After the full local suite, the polar rejection probe and audit harness were refined to require the projection error, and trailing blank lines in two tests were removed. No engine/compiler code changed. Final focused compiler+actual native suite:12 passed. Exact final snapshot is also validated by publication CI.
